caption:
Stuffed Bhindi
vegan | easy recipe | home food 101
C: 18 | F: 11 | P: 4
Calories: 180 per serve
Makes 2 serve

Ingredients
250 grams Bhindi
1 - 2 tbsp oil
pinch of hing

Stuffing mix: 
1 tbsp coriander powder
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1/2 tbsp aamchur powder
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1/2 tsp jeera powder
1/2 tsp garam masala
1/2 tsp salt

handful of coriander leaves for garnish

Method: 
wash and dry the bhindi, then cut the ends off and slit it through the middle without breaking it into 2 parts
combine all the masalas for the stuffing in a bowl 
stuff each bhindi with the masala 
in a pan, add the oil followed by the pinch of hing
allow to heat then add in the bhindi one by one ensuring they are in one line, not on top of each other , needs to have direct surface contact
cook it on a low low flame as we want to make sure masalas or the bhindi don’t burn, dont add any water either
stir every few minutes
